title: Environmental Impact Assessment
modules: Role And Function Of Environmental Impact
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the overall directive which outlines, guides or sets a context for a proposed action which a government or organization intends to take."
generally policy is regarded as the overall directive which outlines, guides or sets a context for a proposed action which a government or organization intends to take.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of information on the proposed project environment (True/False) ii."
Baseline study is a collection of information on the proposed project environment (True/False) ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool for predicting environmental consequences of a proposed project, plan or programme. ii."
Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is a tool for predicting environmental consequences of a proposed project, plan or programme. ii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "low-level" investigation which focuses on individual issues and environmental inputs to design activities."
Environmental Appraisal is a "low-level" investigation which focuses on individual issues and environmental inputs to design activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the stage where the coverage of the EIA is decided."
The scoping exercise is the stage where the coverage of the EIA is decided.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an analysis of both of these components, and is therefore more than just an impact assessment."
A risk analysis is an analysis of both of these components, and is therefore more than just an impact assessment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a "high-level" process which involves a multi-disciplinary detailed study of the proposal and the environment within which it is to be developed."
EIA is a "high-level" process which involves a multi-disciplinary detailed study of the proposal and the environment within which it is to be developed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential part of baseline data acquisition (Yes/No) iv."
Field survey is an essential part of baseline data acquisition (Yes/No) iv.
fib: ______ is a topic that also could be considered in risk assessment.
Animal welfare
Animal welfare is a topic that also could be considered in risk assessment.
______ is the various stages a proposed activity undergoes from proposal to approval for implementation.
EIA process
The EIA process is the various stages a proposed activity undergoes from proposal to approval for implementation.
______ is the compilation of the findings from an EIA activity or exercise.
Reporting
Reporting is the compilation of the findings from an EIA activity or exercise.
______ is concerned with reducing or minimising environmental impacts at all of these stages in the production process.
Life cycle assessment
Life cycle assessment is concerned with reducing or minimising environmental impacts at all of these stages in the production process.
______ is the various assessment activities and stages that a new proposal undergoes from inception to approval for implementation.
process
The process is the various assessment activities and stages that a new proposal undergoes from inception to approval for implementation.
______ is the analysis and evaluation of the uncertainty of unwanted potential environmental effects which could be problematic and the various measures to reduce risk.
Environmental risk assessment
Environmental risk assessment is the analysis and evaluation of the uncertainty of unwanted potential environmental effects which could be problematic and the various measures to reduce risk.
______ is a key activity to determine whether an EIA is required or not.
Screening
Screening is a key activity to determine whether an EIA is required or not.
